defects.claim: Parity readback comparison ignores buffer length mismatch; truncated second buffer gives NaN deltas and can report zero mismatches
defects.scenario: second readback buffer shorter than the first: missing bytes read as undefined, channel delta and max become NaN, mismatch count can stay zero; a longer second buffer is ignored entirely

defects.claim: Vertex upload tracker records float writes to any buffer target, misattributing them to the last ARRAY_BUFFER or throwing a misleading missing-stride error
defects.scenario: a float upload to a non-ARRAY_BUFFER target is attributed to the previously bound vertex buffer, or throws a missing-stride error
defects.cause: upload capture not filtered by target
